quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation.condition: the subject turns to proceed in the opposite direction; the place is a curve, or the approach to or near the crest of a grade; the subject cannot be seen from 500 feet by a driver approaching from either direction

obligation.description: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

timing.description: the manoeuvre is judged where it is made; the visibility test is geometric at that point

judgment_calls_needed.note: the 500-foot visibility is a sight-line construction: as good as st.sight_distance on the source, and it must be computed in both directions
